          removeQualified();
        }
      }
    }
  });

  observer.observe(document.documentElement, {
    childList: true,
    subtree: true
  });

  // 4. Safety: kill Qualified launcher calls if exposed
  try {
    if (window.qualified) {
      window.qualified = function () {};
    }
  } catch (e) {}
})();
</script>	</div>

<div class="block-summary section-wrapper pt-50 white-bg bg-is-light pop-section" name="security"><a class="anchor" name="anchor-1"></a>
<div class="container">

	<h2 class="dash">Security by Design</h2>
				<div class="desc">
			<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Dataminr has developed and maintains modern security infrastructure and tools including AI-enabled preventative and detective solutions to protect customer assets:</span></p>
<p> </p>
<p><b>Red Teaming & Penetration Testing</b></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Comprehensive application and network penetration testing is conducted at least annually by qualified, independent security firms. Testing providers are rotated to ensure diverse coverage and fresh perspectives on potential vulnerabilities. Third party red teaming including social engineering and AI adversarial testing are conducted at least annually. Additionally, Dataminr’s internal Trust team members conduct pen testing periodically throughout the year to address new products and features. Agentic AI-enabled automated red teaming and penetration testing is conducted continuously throughout the year.</span></p>
<p> </p>
<p><b>Access management</b><b><br>
</b><span style="font-weight: 400;">Dataminr maintains a strict need-based approach to managing user access with unique user identifiers (UUIDs). SAML 2.0 support is available for customers to integrate their preferred Single Sign-On (SSO) solution.</span></p>
<p> </p>
<p><b>Enterprise-Class VPN</b><b><br>
</b><span style="font-weight: 400;">Access to Dataminr’s production environment is protected by a VPN with multi-factor authentication (MFA). </span></p>
<p> </p>
<p><b>Physical Security</b></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Third-party managed data centers incorporate biometric access controls, extensive security cameras, 24/7 security personnel, and maintain a complete log of access events. </span></p>
<p> </p>
<p><b>Secure Development Life Cycle (SDLC)</b><span style="font-weight: 400;"><br>
</span><span style="font-weight: 400;">Dataminr applies a privacy-and-security-by-design approach, including approval processes, segregation of duties, peer code review, automated code scanning, and Quality Assurance (QA). Separate test and production environments are maintained, and customer data is not permitted in Dataminr’s test environment.</span></p>
<p> </p>
<p><b>Configuration Management</b></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Configuration baselines are established and enforced with hardening standards consistently applied. Baseline configurations are kept current and monitored to prevent deviations.</span></p>
<p> </p>
<p><b>Network Security</b></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Dataminr utilizes a multi-layered approach with extensive use of security groups configured to deny all traffic by default and allow only well-defined, permitted traffic. Industry standard Web Application Firewall (WAF) technology is maintained to protect Dataminr’s customer applications.</span></p>
<p> </p>
<p><b>Encryption</b></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Dataminr leverages industry standard encryption technologies to ensure that the confidentiality of customer data is protected. Customer data is encrypted at rest utilizing AES-256 and in motion using TLS 1.2 or higher.</span></p>
<p> </p>
<p><b>Logging and Monitoring</b></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Dataminr conducts infrastructure and application logging utilizing industry standard software solutions. AI-enabled intrusion prevention and detection systems are monitored by Dataminr’s 24/7/365 SOC. Anomalies are promptly investigated and addressed.</span></p>
<p> </p>
<p><b>Architecture</b></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Dataminr utilizes cloud infrastructure as a service (IaaS), leveraging modern containerized micro-service architecture and zero trust network segmentation. Architecture diagrams are maintained and reviewed on an annual basis. </span></p>
<p> </p>
<p><b>Data Loss Prevention (DLP)</b></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Dataminr’s multi-tiered approach to DLP covers both production and corporate information resources. Dataminr’s DLP program enables systematic detection and prevention of suspicious or inappropriate data handling, creating an additional layer of protection for confidential data.</span></p>
<p> </p>
<p><b>Threat Intelligence</b></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Dataminr utilizes third-party threat intelligence services together with internal analysis to assess relevance and any needed mitigation. Real-time threat intelligence information includes, but is not limited to, denial of service, zero day, public exploits, and actively exploited vulnerabilities.</span></p>
<p> </p>
<p><b>Incident Management</b></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Dataminr has implemented a NIST-based incident response plan that includes clearly defined roles and responsibilities, communication requirements, as well as procedures for incident preparation, detection/identification, escalation, containment, eradication, recovery, and lessons learned. Appropriate channels for reporting incidents are communicated and maintained.</span></p>
<p> </p>
<p><b>Asset Management</b></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Dataminr maintains complete asset inventories covering hardware, software, and data resources with asset owners responsible for protecting confidentiality, integrity, and availability throughout the complete life cycle.</span></p>
<p> </p>
<p><b>Third-party Risk</b><b><br>
</b><span style="font-weight: 400;">Dataminr’s third-party risk program includes security assessments of proposed and existing suppliers to ensure comprehensive trust programs have been implemented.</span></p>
<p> </p>
<p><b>Training & Awareness</b></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Employees complete security training upon hire and annually thereafter. Specialized annual training in areas such as secure coding is provided to the appropriate teams. Phishing simulations are conducted on a quarterly basis.</span></p>
<p> </p>
<p><b>Security Operations</b></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Dataminr maintains a 24/7/365 security operations center (SOC) for continuous customer protection. A third-party specialist incident response firm has been retained for rapid support in the unlikely event of a security or privacy incident.</span></p>
<p> </p>
<p><b>Vulnerability Management</b></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Internal and external application and network scans along with dynamic and static application security testing are conducted utilizing industry standard software solutions. Risk treatments are promptly identified, documented, and prioritized by qualified personnel. Dataminr also employs next generation red teaming and administers a private bug bounty program.</span></p>
<p> </p>
<p><b>Resiliency </b></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Dataminr maintains business continuity and disaster recovery (BCDR) plans that outline the procedures to be followed in the event of an availability incident. Testing is conducted at least annually, including a lessons learned component. Additionally, redundant availability zones and cross-region data replication within Dataminr’s AWS infrastructure help to safeguard availability. </span></p>
		</div>
	
</div>
</div>



<div class="block-summary section-wrapper pt-100 white-bg bg-is-light pop-section" name="privacy"><a class="anchor" name="anchor-2"></a>
<div class="container">

	<h2 class="dash">Privacy by Design</h2>
				<div class="desc">
			<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Want to learn more about Dataminr’s privacy practices? Review our </span><a href="https://www.dataminr.com/privacy-policy/"><span style="font-weight: 400; color: #6088ee;">Privacy Policy</span></a><b>.</b></p>
<p> </p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Dataminr is committed to strict protection of personal data for its customers and employees with emphasis in the following areas:</span></p>
<p> </p>
<p><b>Privacy Impact Assessments</b></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Dataminr conducts privacy impact assessments, data processing impact assessments, and other applicable privacy assessments. Privacy controls are implemented to treat identified risks.</span></p>
<p> </p>
<p><b>Data Governance</b></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Dataminr applies data protection and privacy principles to data processing activities, including confidentiality, limitations on data access and use, data minimization, data security, data disposal, and purpose limitation.</span></p>
<p> </p>
<p><b>Data Residency</b></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Dataminr is headquartered in the United States with subsidiaries in Canada, the United Kingdom, Ireland, France, Germany, Denmark, and Australia. Dataminr’s platform is hosted on AWS in Northern Virginia, United States.</span></p>
<p> </p>
<p><b>Privacy Affiliations</b></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Dataminr’s dedicated privacy and security professionals hold certifications from organizations such as the Information Systems Audit and Control Association (ISACA) and the International Association of Privacy Professionals (IAPP). Dataminr is a corporate member of the IAPP.</span></p>
<p> </p>
<p><b>Regulatory Compliance</b><b><br>
</b><span style="font-weight: 400;">Dataminr has implemented processes and technologies to comply with GDPR, CCPA, and other global privacy regulations.</span></p>
<p> </p>
<p><b>Data Processing Addendums (DPAs)</b></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Dataminr uses a data processing addendum, where appropriate, to address relevant responsibilities, restrictions and obligations when Dataminr is acting in the data processing role (or other similar terms).</span></p>
<p> </p>
<p><b>Cross-border Data Transfers</b></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Personal data is only transferred across borders with appropriate mechanisms applied, in accordance with data processing terms. </span></p>
<p> </p>
<p><b>Data Subject Requests (DSRs)</b></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Dataminr has procedures to assist customers (who act as Personal Data Controllers) in addressing data subject requests. Documented DSR procedures ensure requests are processed accurately and promptly.</span></p>
<p> </p>
<p><b>Training & Awareness</b></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Employees complete privacy training upon hire and annually thereafter covering the U.S. Privacy Act, the EU GDPR, and the CCPA.</span></p>
<p> </p>
<p><b>Third-party Risk</b><b><br>
</b><span style="font-weight: 400;">Dataminr’s third-party risk program includes privacy assessments of proposed and existing suppliers to ensure appropriate privacy practices have been implemented.</span></p>
		</div>
	
</div>
</div>



<div class="block-summary section-wrapper pt-100 white-bg bg-is-light pop-section" name="ai governance"><a class="anchor" name="anchor-3"></a>
<div class="container">

	<h2 class="dash">AI Governance</h2>
				<div class="desc">
			<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Dataminr integrates Trust by Design practices throughout the complete AI system life cycle, from initial planning and development through deployment and operations.</span></p>
<p> </p>
<p><b>Responsibl</b><b>e </b><b>AI Framework</b></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Dataminr is among the first 40 organizations worldwide to earn ISO 42001 AI Governance certification, demonstrating our strong commitment to internationally recognized standards for Responsible AI. This certification provides third-party assurance of our AI governance practices. Additionally, Dataminr has adopted NIST’s AI Risk Management Framework. </span></p>
<p> </p>
<p><b>Reliability & Safety </b></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Our AI systems undergo rigorous testing protocols including adversarial testing, performance validation across diverse scenarios, and safeguards to help prevent false positives. We maintain human oversight processes to ensure consistent performance and appropriate model behavior.</span></p>
<p> </p>
<p><b>Continuous Improvement </b></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We continuously monitor our AI systems and implement iterative improvements based on quality assessments, performance metrics, emerging best practices, and customer feedback. </span></p>
<p> </p>
<p><b>Training & Awareness</b></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Employees complete AI governance training upon hire and annually thereafter. Specialized annual training in areas such as OWASP Top 10 Risk and Mitigations for LLMs & GenAI Applications is provided to the appropriate teams.</span></p>
<p> </p>
<p><b>Third-party Risk</b></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Dataminr maintains a third-party risk program that includes AI assessments of proposed and existing suppliers to ensure AI governance.</span></p>
<p> </p>
<p><b>Model Testing</b></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Standardized procedures for ensuring optimal training, validation, and testing datasets are enforced, and potential impacts on model performance are carefully considered. Dataminr rigorously tests its AI models to identify any vulnerabilities and weaknesses, leveraging the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, as well as a specialized model scanning solution. Additionally, third party adversarial model testing is conducted at least annually.</span></p>
		</div>
	
</div>
</div>

<div class="block-summary section-wrapper pt-50 pb-100 white-bg bg-is-light pop-section" name="compliance-desc"><a class="anchor" name="anchor-5"></a>
<div class="container">

	<h2 class="dash"></h2>
				<div class="desc">
			<p><b>Customer Assurance</b></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Dataminr maintains multiple industry-leading certifications and compliance attestations which are verified annually by top internationally accredited third-party auditors:</span></p>
<p> </p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">ISO 42001: International standard that provides a framework for establishing, implementing, and maintaining an AI Management System (AIMS) to ensure responsible development, governance, and use of AI.</span></p>
<p> </p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">ISO 27001: Leading international standard for establishing, implementing, and maintaining an Information Security Management System (ISMS), providing a systematic approach to manage security risk and protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data.</span></p>
<p> </p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">ISO 27701: Extension to ISO 27001 that provides requirements and guidance for establishing, implementing, and maintaining a Privacy Information Management System (PIMS) to help organizations comply with international privacy regulations like GDPR.</span></p>
<p> </p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">NIST 800-171: U.S. federal standard that specifies security requirements for protecting Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) in non-federal systems.</span></p>
<p> </p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">SOC 2 Type 2: AICPA-sanctioned independent attestation that examines the design and operational effectiveness of a service organization’s controls over a specified time period.</span></p>
<p> </p>
<p><strong>Compliance Program Management</strong></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Dataminr’s compliance program includes regular internal assessments and continuous control monitoring. Formal management review of the overall Trust program is conducted at least quarterly, including review of risk treatment plans and remediation activities. Compliance requirements are addressed throughout the software development lifecycle.</span></p>
<p> </p>
<p><strong>Regulatory Alignment</strong></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Our compliance program addresses requirements across multiple international frameworks and jurisdictions, including GDPR, CCPA, and the U.S. Privacy Act for data protection, as well as alignment with the NIST AI Risk Management Framework for AI governance.</span></p>

<script>
/**
 * PAGE: Department of War Landing Page (ID: 29472)
 * URL: https://www.dataminr.com/?page_id=29472
 * 
 * PURPOSE: Adds 2 extra CTA links below the existing ACF "Learn More" link
 * in the .static-video-grid block, all opening as lightbox demos via Navattic.
 * 
 * CTAs:
 *  1. "LEARN MORE" (existing ACF link) → https://dataminr.navattic.com/v41t0aev
 *  2. "SHAREPOINT INTEGRATION SELF-GUIDED DEMO" → https://threat-connect.navattic.com/mmv05em
 *  3. "APT41 INTEGRATION SELF-GUIDED DEMO" → https://threat-connect.navattic.com/na1i0wvi
 * 
 * HOW IT WORKS:
 *  - Preloads all 3 Navattic iframes silently on page load
 *  - On click, moves preloaded iframe into a lightbox overlay (faster open)
 *  - Shows loading spinner while iframe initializes
 *  - Only fires on page-id-29472, safe to live in global footer
 * 
 * AUTHOR: Vedant Soni
 * LAST UPDATED: April 2026
 */
if (document.body.classList.contains('page-id-29472')) {

  const demos = [
    'https://dataminr.navattic.com/v41t0aev',
    'https://threat-connect.navattic.com/mmv05em',
    'https://threat-connect.navattic.com/na1i0wvi'
  ];

  // Preload all 3 iframes hidden in DOM on page load
  function preloadIframes() {
    demos.forEach(url => {
      const iframe = document.createElement('iframe');
      iframe.src = url;
      iframe.id = 'iframe-' + btoa(url);
      iframe.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;';
      document.body.appendChild(iframe);
    });
  }

  function openNavattic(url) {
    let overlay = document.getElementById('navattic-overlay');
    if (!overlay) {
      overlay = document.createElement('div');
      overlay.id = 'navattic-overlay';
      overlay.style.cssText = 'display:none;position:fixed;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.85);z-index:99999;align-items:center;justify-content:center;';

      const close = document.createElement('button');
      close.textContent = '✕';
      close.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;top:20px;right:30px;background:none;border:none;color:white;font-size:28px;cursor:pointer;z-index:100000;';
      close.onclick = () => {
        overlay.style.display = 'none';
        // move iframe back to preload container
        const active = overlay.querySelector('iframe');
        if (active) {
          active.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;';
          document.body.appendChild(active);
        }
      };

      overlay.appendChild(close);
      overlay.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        if (e.target === overlay) {
          overlay.style.display = 'none';
          const active = overlay.querySelector('iframe');
          if (active) {
            active.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;';
            document.body.appendChild(active);
          }
        }
      });
      document.body.appendChild(overlay);
    }

    // Move the preloaded iframe into the overlay
    const iframe = document.getElementById('iframe-' + btoa(url));
    if (iframe) {
      iframe.style.cssText = 'width:90%;height:90vh;border:none;border-radius:8px;';
      overlay.appendChild(iframe);
    }

    overlay.style.display = 'flex';
  }

  (function() {
    function addCTAs() {
      const existingCTA = document.querySelector('.static-video-grid .links .cta-link');
      if (!existingCTA) { setTimeout(addCTAs, 100); return; }
      if (existingCTA.parentNode.querySelectorAll('.cta-link').length > 1) return;

      preloadIframes();

      existingCTA.parentNode.style.cssText = 'display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:12px;';

      existingCTA.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        openNavattic('https://dataminr.navattic.com/v41t0aev');
      });

      const ctas = [
        { text: 'THIRD-PARTY RISK SELF-GUIDED DEMO', url: 'https://threat-connect.navattic.com/mmv05em' },
        { text: 'THREAT ACTOR TRACKING SELF-GUIDED DEMO',      url: 'https://threat-connect.navattic.com/na1i0wvi' },
      ];

      ctas.forEach(cta => {
        const link = document.createElement('a');
        link.href = '#';
        link.textContent = cta.text;
        link.className = 'cta-link';
        link.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
          e.preventDefault();
          openNavattic(cta.url);
        });
        existingCTA.parentNode.appendChild(link);
      });
    }
    addCTAs();
  })();
}
